##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 18 September 2026 at 10:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Complex area of low pressure near Iceland as a waving frontal zone affects the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or southwest 5 or 6, decreasing 4 in places later.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, occasionally rough at first, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Isolated rain or showers, becoming fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain or showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or southwest 5 or 6, veering west 4 or 5 later Sunday morning, backing southwest 3 or 4 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
